description.zh: 基于爱德华·德波诺「六顶思考帽」平行思考法的决策推演工作台。输入任一议题，蓝帽先行编排流程，白/绿/黄/黑/红五顶帽子依次登台，从事实、创意、价值、风险、直觉五个维度递进审议，最后由蓝帽收束为一份含决策建议的完整报告。全程串行推进、本地留档、可导出 Markdown。
description.en: A decision workbench built on Edward de Bono's Six Thinking Hats. Blue plans the sequence, the White/Green/Yellow/Black/Red hats deliberate in turn, then Blue synthesizes a decision report.

releaseNotes.zh: 修正英文描述超长导致 manifest 无法加载的问题（官方上限 200 字符）；同步强化打包与体检工具的规范校验。
releaseNotes.en: Fixed the English description exceeding the 200-character manifest limit that blocked loading. Hardened the packaging and validation tooling.
